_doc: What goes to Firebase /state (Google sees it). topic may use +; {1},{2} in key and label = the + parts. Labels are English; i18n translates them for the phones. The house adds its own words per language in "i18n", e.g. {"de": {"Front door": "Haustuer"}}. The bridge account reads only family/# and home/state/#: other topics never arrive.
